novelty_flags.label: Proposition 1 — Assaad reduction
novelty_flags.one_line: The claimed one-way transfer to an arbitrary subclass is already an immediate corollary of Assaad's Theorem 10, not an independent research result.

soundness_flags.label: Proposition 1 — Assaad reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: Once \(\mathcal K\subseteq\mathcal A_D\) is assumed, the proposition only specializes Assaad's published theorem and adds no substantive derivation.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Main identification frontier
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: All common-fiber conclusions are conditional on the positive linear-Gaussian baseline-parent modular-intervention class with invariant innovations and diff-faithfulness.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Identification and nonidentification claims are only for retained positive-real, within-environment-CI-free strata of \(\mathcal M_p^{\mathrm{df}}\).

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Four-vertex audit and higher-dimensional frontier
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The exhaustive assertion is confined to labelled \(p=4\); the \(p\ge5\) necessity lift remains an open-ended question.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The certified finite result is a four-node common-fiber frontier, not a general completeness theorem.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Confidence union
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Coverage is conditional on independent centered Gaussian sampling and is finite-sample coverage only.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The confidence-union claim is \(1-\gamma\) coverage over \(\mathcal M_p^{\mathrm{df}}\), with no asserted efficiency, contraction rate, or non-Gaussian extension.

The paper parameterizes attainable total effects by covariance matrices and constructs structure-uncertainty confidence sets by inversion of tests over admissible DAGs.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Remove Proposition 1 from the solve-target list or replace it with a genuinely nontrivial strict-separation result: an exact common-fiber law where the target is identified although Assaad's C.1/C.2 fail for the published graph-wide class.

Turn the p=4 artifact from an intensional protocol plus one worked row into a reproducible certificate bundle with per-cell counts, CAD/Nullstellensatz outputs, support-coverage witnesses, and machine-checkable remainder records.

Sharpen the p≥5 question into a minimal-obstruction contraction theorem with an explicit active-trek contraction map and a stated lifting invariant for positive same-covariance baseline-modular realizations.

recommended_next_step: Revise by deleting or substantively upgrading the published Assaad-specialization proposition, then advance the retained common-fiber p=4 frontier and p≥5 obstruction route to Stage 0.
